title: UK Regulatory Monitor
subtitle: FCA · PRA · ICO · CMA · FRC — enforcement, guidance, and rulemaking
schedule_note: Updated every 6 hours via GitHub Actions

items.title: CACEIS UK censured and to pay £31.7m to WealthTek clients for weak financial crime controls
items.summary: CACEIS UK, an asset servicing bank, has been censured by the FCA and will make a £31.7m voluntary payment to WealthTek clients for failing to act on information that left clients exposed to the risk of financial crime.

items.title: FCA sets landmark crypto rules to cement the UK’s place as a global hub
items.summary:
Firms supporting people to buy, trade and hold crypto will need to meet clear standards under landmark rules set out by the FCA.

All firms must meet financial resilience requirements including capital and stress testing.

items.title: FCA consults on targeted changes to listing rules for closed-ended investment funds
items.summary: The FCA has published a consultation paper on proposed changes to its UK Listing Rules for closed‑ended investment funds, focused on the management of conflicts of interest.

items.title: Refining the Consumer Duty to give greater confidence to wholesale firms
items.summary: When the FCA introduced the Consumer Duty, we set out to do something simple but transformative: ensure financial services work better for consumers. It was, by design, ambitious. And it is working.

items.title: Payments Vision Delivery Committee update on future retail payments infrastructure
items.summary: The Retail Payments Infrastructure Board (RPIB), led by the Bank of England, recently published a consultation on the future retail payments infrastructure.

items.title: Statutory panel chair appointments confirmed for FCA listing authority and practitioner panels
items.summary: The FCA has announced Kirsty Cooper will take up the role as Chair of the Listing Authority Advisory Panel (LAAP).

items.title: FCA consults on proposals to support strong, consistent standards in the SIPP market
items.summary: The FCA has set out plans to drive greater consistency of standards in self-invested pensions (SIPPs), while maintaining the flexibility and broad investment choice they offer.

items.title: The Bank, FCA and HM Treasury joint statement on Frontier AI models and cyber resilience
items.summary: Statement from the Bank of England, Financial Conduct Authority and HM Treasury

items.title: Commodity traders offer £1m to crisis fund after FCA competition probe
items.summary: The FCA is concerned 11 traders may have shared sensitive information or coordinated trades, potentially restricting competition.

items.title: PRA sets out adjustments to its market risk internal model approach under Basel 3.1
items.summary: The Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA) has today published a consultation on the internal model approach to market risk (IMA), which represents the final piece of Basel 3.1’s implementation in the UK.

items.title: Pension firms must do more for customers in older pensions and fund savings
items.summary: The FCA has found that peopleholding legacy pension products,now closed to newsavers, could be receiving poorer value than those in newer ones.

items.title: Motor finance scheme partially suspended
items.summary: The Upper Tribunal has made an order suspending parts of the scheme. We set out what the partial suspension means for firms and consumers.

items.title: Beyond the headlines: the unseen fight against financial crime
items.summary:
Speech by Therese Chambers, joint executive director of enforcement and market oversight, delivered at the International Bar Association (IBA) Anti-Corruption Conference.

I’ve been practising law for over 3 decades now.

items.title: FCA and Bank of England set out shared vision for tokenisation in UK wholesale markets
items.summary: The Financial Conduct Authority and the Bank of England set out a shared vision and seek industry views on the future of UK wholesale markets

items.title: PRA announces ring-fence change to reduce costs
items.summary: The Prudential Regulation Authority has today announced plans to consult on reforming rules around shared operational services for ring-fenced banks.

items.title: Financial regulator to simplify investment disclosure regime
items.summary: The FCA is proposing to simplify how platforms, advisers and wealth managers communicate the costs of investing while reminding firms to communicate with consumers about investing in plain English.

items.title: Investors get real-time view of UK bond market activity for the first time
items.summary: For the first time, investors and market participants can access a single, real-time source of prices and trading activity across the UK bond market, following the launch of its bond consolidated tape, operated by ETS Connect UK.

items.title: FCA closes investigation into Drax Group PLC
items.summary: Drax Group PLC (Drax) has announced the FCA has closed its investigation into the company.We undertook an extensive investigation following concerns raised regarding disclosures to the market about the sustainability of Drax’s Canadian biomass.

items.title: PRA publishes plans to support resilience in the life insurance industry
items.summary: Funded reinsurance transactions involving UK life insurers will face enhanced regulatory requirements under new proposals unveiled today by the Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA).

items.title: FCA and the Bank of England set out approach to joint regulation of systemic stablecoin issuers
items.summary: The Bank of England and the FCA have published a joint approach setting out how they and where relevant other authorities will work together to regulate systemic stablecoin issuers in the UK.

items.title: Non-UK business removed from Consumer Duty scope to reduce burdens on wholesale businesses
items.summary: Wholesale financial businesses involved in retail markets will find it easier to comply with the Consumer Duty, following proposals from the FCA.

items.title: CMA letter to PHIN welcoming achievement of gold compliance milestone
items.summary: The Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) welcomes the achievement by the Private Healthcare Information Network (PHIN) and the private healthcare industry of the ‘gold milestone’ of full compliance with the CMA’s Private …

items.title: Court endorses CMA action as Emma Sleep agrees to change sales practices
items.summary: The CMA has secured a court-endorsed settlement from mattress firm Emma Sleep after concerns its sales practices misled consumers.

items.title: CMA orders StubHub UK to refund customers over hidden fees
items.summary: StubHub UK must refund more than 50,000 customers and pay a fine close to £900,000.

items.title: CMA orders Marks Electrical to refund customers over pre-selected extra charges
items.summary: Marks Electrical must refund nearly 40,000 customers and pay a fine after it automatically opted customers into additional paid services.

items.title: Bank of England launches policy statement and draft rules on regulating systemic stablecoins
items.summary: The Bank of England has today published its policy statement and draft Code of Practice (rules) for systemic stablecoin issuers.

items.title: Bank of England and Financial Conduct Authority – Memorandum of Understanding on the supervision of Financial Market Infrastructure
items.summary: Joint statement from the Bank of England and Financial Conduct Authority

items.title: CMA correspondence in relation to early years education and childcare sector
items.summary: Letters between the Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) and minsters in UK government.

items.title: FCA and PRA confirm changes to streamline senior manager accountability and boost growth
items.summary: The PRA and FCA have set out reforms to the Senior Managers and Certification Regime, designed to reduce costs and offer greater flexibility.

items.title: Purpose and pragmatism in the UK’s digital markets competition regime
items.summary: A speech by Will Hayter, the CMA’s Executive Director for Digital Markets, delivered at CompLaw: Digital Conference.
